datasets.title: NBA play-by-play
datasets.summary: Every recorded event of every NBA game in one consistent layout: clock, event type, team, up to three players with their roles, running score and shot details. Regular season, play-in, NBA Cup final and playoffs are in one file, told apart by season_type; preseason and the All-Star game are left out.
datasets.source_note: Compiled by Slam Dunk Bets from the NBA's official game statistics play-by-play feed. The league changed the feed's layout over the years; every season here is converted to the same columns, and columns the older feed lacks are blank for those seasons, as the column descriptions say.

columns.name: season
columns.description: Season the game belongs to, written like 2025-26.

columns.name: season_type
columns.description: Part of the season: regular_season, play_in, cup_final (the in-season NBA Cup championship game) or playoffs.

columns.name: game_id
columns.description: League game id, ten digits starting with 00; keep it as text so the leading digits survive.

columns.name: game_date
columns.description: Date of the game in U.S. Eastern time, as the league lists it.

columns.name: home_team
columns.description: Abbreviation of the home team.

columns.name: away_team
columns.description: Abbreviation of the away team.

columns.name: event_seq
columns.description: Position of the event within the game, counting from 1 in the order the league's feed lists the plays.

columns.name: event_num
columns.description: The feed's own event number; it is not always in time order, because corrections are numbered later, so sort by event_seq.

columns.name: period
columns.description: Period of play: 1 to 4 are the 12-minute quarters, 5 and up are 5-minute overtimes.

columns.name: clock
columns.description: Time left in the period as M:SS, with tenths of a second where the feed has them.

columns.name: seconds_remaining
columns.description: Seconds left in the period.

columns.name: seconds_elapsed
columns.description: Seconds of game time played when the event happened, counted from the opening tip across periods.

columns.name: event_type
columns.description: Kind of event: period_start, period_end, jump_ball, made_shot, missed_shot, free_throw, rebound, turnover, foul, violation, substitution, timeout, ejection, instant_replay, heave (an end-of-period heave charged to the team rather than a player, NBA from 2025-26) or other.

columns.name: event_subtype
columns.description: Detail within the event type. Shots: dunk, layup, hook, tip or jump_shot. Free throws: 1_of_2 and so on, technical, flagrant_1_of_2, clear_path_1_of_2. Rebounds: offensive or defensive. Turnovers: bad_pass, lost_ball, traveling, shot_clock, offensive_foul, out_of_bounds, violation or other. Fouls: personal, shooting, offensive, loose_ball, technical, flagrant, take, clear_path, away_from_play, double or other. Violations: defensive_goaltending, kicked_ball, lane, jump_ball, delay_of_game or other. Timeouts: regular, short, reset, official, challenge or other. Blank for other event types.

columns.name: team
columns.description: Abbreviation of the team the event belongs to (the first player's team, or the team itself for team rebounds, team turnovers and timeouts); blank for neutral events.

columns.name: player1_id
columns.description: League id of the main player in the event: the shooter, rebounder, player who turned it over, player who fouled, player leaving on a substitution, or the first jumper.

columns.name: player1_name
columns.description: Full name of the first player.

columns.name: player1_role
columns.description: What the first player did: shooter, rebound, turnover, foul, violation, sub_out, jumper, ejected or other.

columns.name: player2_id
columns.description: League id of the second player: the assist on a made shot, the steal on a turnover, the player fouled, the player entering on a substitution, or the second jumper. From 2025-26 the feed names one player per event, so assists, substitutions and jumpers are matched from the description text and left blank when a name is ambiguous, and the player fouled is not available.

columns.name: player2_name
columns.description: Full name of the second player.

columns.name: player2_role
columns.description: What the second player did: assist, steal, fouled, sub_in, jumper or other.

columns.name: player3_id
columns.description: League id of the third player: the shot blocker on a missed shot, or the player who gained possession on a jump ball (from 2025-26 matched from the description text).

columns.name: player3_name
columns.description: Full name of the third player.

columns.name: player3_role
columns.description: What the third player did: block, tip_recipient or other.

columns.name: home_score
columns.description: Home team's score after the event, counted from the made field goals and free throws up to and including it.

columns.name: away_score
columns.description: Away team's score after the event, counted the same way.

columns.name: shot_made
columns.description: True for a made field goal or free throw, False for a miss, blank for events that are not shots.

columns.name: shot_value
columns.description: Points the shot was worth if made: 3 or 2 for field goals, 1 for free throws; blank otherwise.

columns.name: shot_distance
columns.description: Shot distance in feet for field goal attempts, where the feed reports one; older seasons leave many shots at the rim blank.

columns.name: shot_x
columns.description: Shot location across the court in tenths of a foot, 0 at the basket; populated from 2025-26.

columns.name: shot_y
columns.description: Shot location out from the baseline toward midcourt in tenths of a foot, 0 at the basket; populated from 2025-26.

columns.name: description
columns.description: The league's own text for the play; when a play has a second note (a block or a steal) the two are joined with a vertical bar.

datasets.source_note: Compiled by Slam Dunk Bets from the WNBA's official game statistics play-by-play feed. columns.description: Abbreviation of the away team.

columns.description: Position of the event within the game, counting from 1 in the order the league's feed lists the plays.

columns.description: The feed's own event number; it is not always in time order, because corrections are numbered later, so sort by event_seq.

columns.name: period
columns.description: Period of play: 1 to 4 are the 10-minute quarters, 5 and up are 5-minute overtimes.

columns.description: Time left in the period as M:SS, with tenths of a second where the feed has them.

columns.description: Seconds left in the period.

columns.description: Seconds of game time played when the event happened, counted from the opening tip across periods.

columns.description: Kind of event: period_start, period_end, jump_ball, made_shot, missed_shot, free_throw, rebound, turnover, foul, violation, substitution, timeout, ejection, instant_replay, heave (an end-of-period heave charged to the team rather than a player, NBA from 2025-26) or other.

columns.name: event_subtype
columns.description: Detail within the event type. Shots: dunk, layup, hook, tip or jump_shot. Free throws: 1_of_2 and so on, technical, flagrant_1_of_2, clear_path_1_of_2. Rebounds: offensive or defensive. Turnovers: bad_pass, lost_ball, traveling, shot_clock, offensive_foul, out_of_bounds, violation or other. Fouls: personal, shooting, offensive, loose_ball, technical, flagrant, take, clear_path, away_from_play, double or other. Violations: defensive_goaltending, kicked_ball, lane, jump_ball, delay_of_game or other. Timeouts: regular, short, reset, official, challenge or other. Blank for other event types.

columns.description: Full name of the first player.

columns.name: player1_role
columns.description: What the first player did: shooter, rebound, turnover, foul, violation, sub_out, jumper, ejected or other.

columns.description: What the second player did: assist, steal, fouled, sub_in, jumper or other.

columns.name: away_score

columns.description: True for a made field goal or free throw, False for a miss, blank for events that are not shots.

columns.description: Points the shot was worth if made: 3 or 2 for field goals, 1 for free throws; blank otherwise.

columns.description: REG for the regular season, POST for the playoffs.

columns.name: game_type
columns.description: Round of the season: REG (regular season), WC (wild card), DIV (divisional), CON (conference championship), SB (Super Bowl).

columns.name: week
columns.description: Week of the season; playoff weeks continue the count after the last regular-season week.

columns.name: game_date
columns.description: Date of the game in US Eastern time.

columns.name: weekday
columns.description: Day of the week the game is played.

columns.name: kickoff_time_et
columns.description: Scheduled kickoff, US Eastern time, 24-hour HH:MM.

columns.name: away_team
columns.description: Away team abbreviation; one code per franchise in every season (LV, LAC and LA also cover the Oakland, San Diego and St. Louis years).

columns.name: home_team
columns.description: Home team abbreviation; one code per franchise in every season (LV, LAC and LA also cover the Oakland, San Diego and St. Louis years).

columns.name: away_score
columns.description: Final points for the away team, overtime included; blank until the game is played.

columns.name: home_score
columns.description: Final points for the home team, overtime included; blank until the game is played.

columns.name: home_margin
columns.description: Home score minus away score; negative when the away team won, blank until the game is played.

columns.name: total_points
columns.description: Home score plus away score; blank until the game is played.

columns.name: overtime
columns.description: True if the game went to overtime; blank until the game is played.

columns.name: neutral_site
columns.description: True if the game is played at a neutral site (international games, the Super Bowl), where the home team is the designated one.

columns.name: division_game
columns.description: True if the two teams are in the same division.

columns.name: away_rest_days
columns.description: Days since the away team's previous game; 7 for a season opener.

columns.name: home_rest_days
columns.description: Days since the home team's previous game; 7 for a season opener.

columns.name: roof
columns.description: Stadium roof: outdoors, dome, or closed / open for a retractable roof.

columns.name: surface
columns.description: Playing surface, such as grass or fieldturf; can be blank for recent games until nflverse fills it in.

columns.name: temperature_f
columns.description: Temperature at kickoff in degrees Fahrenheit; blank for domes, closed roofs and games not yet played.

columns.name: wind_mph
columns.description: Wind speed at kickoff in miles per hour; blank for domes, closed roofs and games not yet played.

columns.name: away_qb_id
columns.description: Player id (NFL GSIS id) of the away team's starting quarterback; blank until the game is played.

columns.name: away_qb_name
columns.description: Name of the away team's starting quarterback; blank until the game is played.

columns.name: home_qb_id
columns.description: Player id (NFL GSIS id) of the home team's starting quarterback; blank until the game is played.

columns.name: home_qb_name
columns.description: Name of the home team's starting quarterback; blank until the game is played.

columns.name: away_coach
columns.description: Head coach of the away team.

columns.name: home_coach
columns.description: Head coach of the home team.

columns.name: referee
columns.description: Referee of the game; blank until the crew is recorded.

columns.name: stadium_id
columns.description: Stadium id used by Pro Football Reference.

columns.name: stadium
columns.description: Stadium name.

columns.name: nfl_game_id
columns.description: The NFL's own ten-digit id for the game.

columns.name: pfr_game_id
columns.description: Pro Football Reference id for the game.

columns.name: espn_game_id
columns.description: ESPN id for the game.
